issues: Abstract drift risk is elevated: intake does not sufficiently lock object-first behavior.
fixes: Add anti-drift rules and explicit bans on texture-only, atmosphere-first, and abstract-first outcomes.

revised_intake.creative_intent: Generate a single, perfectly engineered ceramic sphere with a clean matte boron carbide (B4C) finish, emphasizing material properties and manufactured object readability within a material-only scope.

must_have: exactly one manufactured object as the clear subject
visible contour evidence such as edge, rim, bevel, seam, or curvature
material visibly attached to the object, not floating as texture
visible edge, rim, bevel, seam, or contour evidence
material visibly attached to the object

composition.framing: Centered composition, full object clearly visible
composition.camera: straight-on, neutral lens, no distortion, no blur
composition.background: minimal brutalist concrete background, Obsidian Black #0A0A0A background

lighting.style: strict chiaroscuro 4:1 ratio, single directional hard light
constraints: color must remain subordinate to material identity
color must follow form then material, never override them
no flat color, always material texture variation
pure white and pure black are forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones

core_risks: material misread as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
anti_drift_rules: Lock the object read and prevent abstract drift
Prioritize clean matte B4C technical ceramic read
Prioritize dry, dense, engineered manufactured-object readability
Preserve material-only scope without losing the manufactured object read
always preserve one clearly readable manufactured object
do not let texture or atmosphere become the subject
keep material identity locked and explicit
form -> material -> color priority is mandatory
do not allow neon, pure white, pure black, or plastic-clean RGB drift
crimson may appear only as restrained seam/core accent when applicable
do not allow abstract, texture-only, or atmosphere-first subject drift
keep material identity explicit and stable
success_criteria: Clean matte B4C technical ceramic read
image does not collapse into abstract texture or atmosphere
color feels subtractive and pigment-like, never RGB-clean
shadow mass dominates and color remains materially grounded
image does not read as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
revised_intake.direction_summary: Focus on a single, perfectly engineered ceramic sphere made of matte boron carbide (B4C). Ensure a clean, dry, dense, and manufactured material read, avoiding any glossy, plastic, or toy-like finishes. Maintain a clear subject identity and contour within a material-only scope, preventing abstract drift or subject loss.
